test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-2) Official Paper (Held On: 13 June 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following countries is the largest milk producer in the world in 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is __**India.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• With** 22% of worldwide **milk output, India is the **world's top producer**.
 
• The** United States, China, Pakistan, and Brazil** are next.
 
• The majority of the development in milk production during the **1970s** has occurred in **South Asia,** which is the primary engine of milk production growth in the developing world.
 
• **New Zealand, the United States of America, Germany, France, Australia, and Ireland** have the** highest **milk surpluses.
 
• The nations with the** greatest milk deficits** are **China, Italy, the Russian Federation, Mexico, Algeria, and Indonesia.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Uttar Pradesh** is the **top milk-producing state** in India, contributing **17%** of the nation's total production.
 
• Uttar Pradesh has the **highest buffalo population** in the country and the **second highest cattle population.**
 
• The majority of rural population in the state is engaged in** livestock and dairying.**
 
• Number two and third place are held by** Rajasthan (11.5%) and Andhra Pradesh (9%)** respectively, in milk production.
